caption:
A simple daily AI routine for small business owners (2 minutes)

Most mornings start with whatever pings first. This one prompt gives you a plan before the phone takes over.

Copy this:

"Here's my day: [PASTE CALENDAR + TOP 5 TO-DOS]. Pick the one task that matters most, flag anything that clashes, and write a 3-line plan for my morning."

I tried it on a sample day: it put the client quote first, noticed the 40-minute drive before an 11:30 site visit and told me when to leave.

How to make it stick:
1) Save the prompt in your phone's notes.
2) Paste your calendar and to-dos as they are, no tidying.
3) Do the first line of the plan before opening email.

Send this to someone who still plans the day in their head. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
